subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about winning lapsed {Brand} users back to a paid plan. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the validated conversion, a lapsed user who returns and completes a paid subscription event that clears your billing, read back through a server-to-server postback and held through the trial and first-renewal window so a refund or failed charge never counts. At scale we hold around 2,400 of those a day off retargeting. If it helps, I can pull the lapsed-cohort read by plan tier. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate validated-conversion postback proof
illustrative_flags: 2,400 validated conversions a day off retargeting (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN health_and_fitness retargeting: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof point from parent (validated conversion via S2S postback + trial/first-renewal validation window); one illustrative MobUpps figure (2,400/day); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native English; no 'X, not Y'.
